name: Mwari / Mwali (Shona)

domain_history.domain: high god, oracular voice delivered through mediums at cave shrines (principal historical shrine: Njelele/Matonjeni, Matopo Hills), consulted especially for rainmaking and political counsel

notes: M.L. Daneel, The God of the Matopo Hills: An Essay on the Mwari Cult in Rhodesia (Mouton, 1970), based on 1965-67 fieldwork — foundational modern academic study. Served both Shona/Kalanga and, after Ndebele settlement in the 1830s-40s, Ndebele consultors. See trad_shona_religion for the disputed relationship to Great Zimbabwe/Rozvi political power.
